dedupe_keys.name: dataset to unraveling radical and oxygenate routes in the oxidative dehydrogenation of propane over boron nitride

description: Dataset to: Unraveling Radical and Oxygenate Routes in the Oxidative Dehydrogenation of Propane over Boron Nitride is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by PSI Data Catalog. In this dataset the oxidative dehydrogenation of propane (ODHP) was investigated over BN and VOx catalysts using Photoelectron Photoion Coincidence (PEPICO) coincidence techniques. The data is part of a manuscript submitted to the Journal of the American Chemical Society, entitled " Unraveling Radical and Oxygenate Routes in the Oxidative Dehydrogenation of Propane over Boron Nitride". Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher PSI Data Catalog. The portal shows 2026-09-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by-sa. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
